how_to.title: Upload Image
how_to.desc: Drag and drop or click to select an image from your device. Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP formats up to 10MB.

how_to.title: AI Processing
how_to.desc: Click "Remove Background" and let the AI model process your image locally. First run loads the model (10-30s); subsequent runs are nearly instant.

how_to.title: Download
how_to.desc: Save your transparent PNG with one click. No watermarks, no registration, no limits on commercial use.

faq.q: Is this background remover really free?
faq.a: Yes, completely free with no usage limits, no watermarks, and no registration required. Unlike many "free" tools that charge after a few uses or add watermarks, SmartImgKit is genuinely free for all users, forever.

faq.q: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All processing happens locally in your browser using WebAssembly and ONNX Runtime. Your images never leave your device. We cannot see, store, or analyze your images because we never receive them. This is the most privacy-friendly way to use AI background removal.
JPG, PNG, and WebP are supported for input. The output is always a transparent PNG file that preserves the full quality and dimensions of your original image.

faq.q: How accurate is the AI model?
faq.a: The AI model performs well on product photos, portraits with clear backgrounds, and objects with distinct edges. Complex hair, fur, or translucent areas (glass, water) may require minor touch-ups in dedicated image editing software. The model continues to improve as the open-source project evolves.

faq.q: Can I use this for commercial projects?
faq.a: Yes, you can use the output images for personal and commercial purposes. There are no restrictions. The images you process and the results you generate are entirely yours to use as you see fit.

faq.q: Why does the first use take longer?
faq.a: On first use, the AI model (40-170MB depending on quality) needs to download to your browser's cache. This is a one-time download per model. After that, the model is cached and processing takes only 2-10 seconds per image. The download progress is shown on screen.

faq.q: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.a: Yes, the tool works on mobile browsers (Chrome Mobile, Safari iOS). However, processing may be slower on devices with limited RAM. For the best experience, we recommend using a desktop or laptop computer, especially for processing multiple images.

SmartImgKit works on all modern browsers: Chrome 91+, Firefox 90+, Safari 15+, and Edge 91+. The tool requires WebAssembly support, which all modern browsers provide. For the fastest processing, we recommend Chrome or Firefox.

faq.q: Can I process multiple images at once?
faq.a: Currently, images are processed one at a time. After downloading a result, click "New Image" to immediately process another. Since the AI model stays loaded in memory, subsequent images process very quickly (2-5 seconds each). Batch processing of multiple images is on our roadmap.

faq.q: How is this different from other background removers?
faq.a: Most background removers send your images to a server for processing, which raises privacy concerns and requires uploading/downloading. SmartImgKit processes everything in your browser — no uploads, no privacy risks, no waiting for file transfers. It's also completely free with no limits, unlike services that charge per image or require subscriptions.
